material.description: Blocking fact for content-tree-layer-not-converged: the 2,392 w3 tree records (ATtr 1141, NTtw 756, CTtr 495, sum checked in scenarios/moba/doodad-types-w3.tsv) have no 54-byte doodads.bin on disk, so convert-688g-map.mjs (DOO_RECORD = 54, reads doodads.bin from its --src extract) cannot convert the tree layer. Searched in this run: codesearch filename 'adapter' under the hy3d root returns only tools/bpy-venv requests/adapters.py; codesearch literal '54-byte' under hy3d returns 0 matches in the 2036 scanned files; a walk of hy3d for doodad*.bin returns none; hy3d/output/map-diff holds only TSV and OSD forms (doodads-w3.tsv, doodad-types-w3.tsv, doodads-w3-placed.tsv, map-w3.osd, map-w3-full.osd). The oscraft tree has no gen-w3-map.mjs although the placer header and map.osd comment still name it. Witness now: map.osd tree lines 3479, mapped 1330 at HEAD 828edc06. Clearing action: run the hy3d adapter in its owning checkout to emit doodads.bin for the w3 target (16-byte header, 54-byte records for the 2392 tree records, 8-byte special block) into an --src dir, then run convert-688g-map.mjs --src <dir> and witness the tree count in map.osd. Do not regenerate pathability by hand.

material.subject: Blocker: no hy3d 54-byte adapter output on disk for the w3 tree layer
material.witness: The blocker (no hy3d adapter output for the w3 tree layer) is resolved: tree-compare.summary.md (session verify-tree-layer-688g) gives 3475 tree lines in map.osd at cd85d6d7 matched one-to-one within 2 milli to 6.88g tree records (ATtr 1567, NTtw 1470, CTtr 400, NTtc 38, delta 0, 659 buckets agree). The 6.88w3 mismatch is a separate decision; pathability is UNVERIFIED. The comparison file is in /workspace/hy3d/output/688g-data/tree-compare.tsv.
